blindness_disclosure: Not fully blind for the 10 regression records. This session already read the full round-1 disagreement record in detail earlier today (all 4 root causes and every per-record disagreement description for comparator 007/040/042/048/053/054/056/069/074/075), and read guide revision 2's own worked examples, which directly state the resolved annotation for specific disputed elements of comparator 048 (boundary/coreference), 069 and 074 (qualifier typing). This exposure was not sought during this annotation pass -- no round-one annotation file, receipt, or the disagreement record itself was reopened during this pass -- but prior knowledge from earlier this session could not be un-learned. Consistent with the guide's own framing (Section 11.1: the regression set is explicitly a non-blind regression test, not a blind generalization test) and with the disclosure practice used in round 1's Claude receipt. For the 4 fresh records (012/073/008/030), the only prior exposure was the selector manifest's mechanical feature_evidence/leakage data seen during manifest verification -- clause splits and cue-word counts, not semantic annotations -- no proposition/state/role/qualifier/coreference content for these records was seen before this pass.
method_disclosure: Every record independently read from the frozen manifest only. Propositions, spans, states, roles, qualifiers, coreference, duplicate links, and field obligations determined by direct application of guide Sections 2-9 to each record's raw source and committed target. Exact character spans located programmatically via source-text search to avoid manual offset errors, then schema-validated against guide Section 10's fail-closed rules (sequential IDs, canonical ordering, backward-only duplicate links, non-task action prohibition, exact span text, no overlapping/unsorted intervals) before sealing -- zero validation errors.
